    About this prototype

    Demo content only

    Every stall is a labeled sample. No real businesses, names or photos are used. Real photos, supplied by each approved business, will appear in the profile frames.

    Street and stalls are separate

    The architecture is one illustration; each stall is its own component drawn from a business record. Adding, moving or editing a business never touches the street.

    Drawn from real references

    The gateway follows photos of the Front Street arch: fieldstone pillars, weathering-steel frieze and the TEMECULA EST. 1859 medallion. Named landmarks are historic buildings listed by the City of Temecula, grouped for the illustration.

    The directory stays close

    The list above opens the same profiles. In Phase 2 it grows into the full searchable directory with category filters.
